title: Jesus... What If You Knew What I Actually Did?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, what if You knew what I actually did?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Not the small things. The one I have never said.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know it. I knew it before you walked in here.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why are You still talking to me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Because knowing it was never the thing that would make Me leave.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I keep waiting for You to say it out loud so I can feel it properly.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You have already said it to yourself a thousand times. It did not heal you once.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Bringing it to Me instead of rehearsing it alone. I am faithful. I will not use it against you.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It is not bigger than Me. Nothing you have done has made Me want you less.

bible.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.
